items.source:
Normally it will have been started, but listeners are free to inspect the server and
stop and start it if they want to.
items.translation: 通常情况下它应该已经启动，但监听器可以自由地检查服务器，并根据需要停止或重新启动它。

items.source: Access the application context that the server was created in.
items.translation: 访问服务器创建时所在的应用程序上下文。

items.source:
Access the application context that the server was created in. Sometimes it is
prudent to check that this matches expectations (like being equal to the current
context) before acting on the server itself.
items.translation: 访问服务器创建时所在的应用程序上下文。有时在操作服务器之前，检查该上下文是否符合预期（例如与当前上下文相等）是明智的。

items.source: the applicationContext that the server was created from
items.translation: 服务器创建所使用的 applicationContext
